mapper.update: update issue_projection_states set task_issue_link_id=#{value.taskIssueLinkId},connection_id=#{value.connectionId}, project_mapping_id=#{value.projectMappingId},project_mapping_version=#{value.projectMappingVersion}, project_mapping_schema_hash=#{value.projectMappingSchemaHash}, canonical_document_schema_version=#{value.canonicalDocumentSchemaVersion}, canonical_document_hash=#{value.canonicalDocumentHash},desired_state=#{value.desiredState}, observed_state=#{value.observedState},lifecycle_state=#{value.lifecycleStatus}, failure_classification=#{value.failureClassification},recovery_strategy=#{value.recoveryStrategy}, conflict_policy=#{value.conflictPolicy},desired_payload_hash=#{value.desiredPayloadHash}, observed_payload_hash=#{value.observedPayloadHash},last_applied_domain_event_id=#{value.lastAppliedDomainEventId}, operation_sequence=#{value.operationSequence},projection_version=#{value.projectionVersion}, superseded_by=#{value.supersededBy},retry_count=#{value.retryCount},max_attempts=#{value.maxAttempts}, next_retry_at=#{value.nextRetryAt},last_error_code=#{value.lastErrorCode},last_error_message=#{value.lastErrorMessage}, version=#{value.version},updated_at=#{value.updatedAt},completed_at=#{value.completedAt} where tenant_id=#{value.tenantId} and projection_id=#{value.projectionId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select * from issue_projection_states where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and projection_id=#{projectionId}

select * from issue_projection_states where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and projection_aggregate_key=#{aggregateKey} and lifecycle_state not in ('SUPERSEDED','DISABLED') order by projection_version desc limit 1
select * from issue_projection_states where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and source_event_id=#{sourceEventId}
select * from issue_projection_states where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and task_issue_link_id=#{taskIssueLinkId} order by updated_at desc limit 1
select * from issue_projection_states where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and task_id=#{taskId} and lifecycle_state<>'SUPERSEDED' order by updated_at desc limit 1
select * from issue_projection_states where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and lifecycle_state=#{state} order by updated_at desc limit #{limit}
select * from issue_projection_states where lifecycle_state='FAILED' and recovery_strategy='RETRY' and next_retry_at is not null and next_retry_at<=#{now} order by next_retry_at limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into issue_projection_event_receipts(tenant_id,domain_event_id,projection_id,operation_sequence,payload_hash,applied_at) values(#{tenantId},#{domainEventId},#{projectionId},#{operationSequence},#{payloadHash},#{appliedAt}) on conflict(tenant_id,domain_event_id) do nothing
mapper.update: update issue_projection_reconciliation_cases set status=#{value.status},next_attempt_at=#{value.nextAttemptAt},attempt_count=#{value.attemptCount},last_error=#{value.lastError},resolved_by=#{value.resolvedBy},resolution_reason=#{value.resolutionReason},updated_at=#{value.updatedAt},resolved_at=#{value.resolvedAt} where tenant_id=#{value.tenantId} and case_id=#{value.caseId}
mapper.select: select * from issue_projection_reconciliation_cases where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and case_id=#{caseId}

select * from issue_projection_reconciliation_cases where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and projection_id=#{projectionId} and status in ('OPEN','RETRY_SCHEDULED','WAIT_HUMAN') order by created_at desc limit 1
select * from issue_projection_reconciliation_cases where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and status=#{status} order by created_at desc limit #{limit}
